name: How do professional window leak repairs differ from simple window replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do professional window leak repairs differ from simple window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional window air leak repair focuses on sealing existing gaps and improving the performance of your current windows without replacing the entire unit. This is often a more cost-effective solution for homes with otherwise functional windows experiencing drafts. Window replacement, conversely, involves removing and installing entirely new window units, which is necessary when windows are severely damaged, inefficient, or structurally compromised. We can assess whether repair or replacement is the most appropriate solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leak repair seals existing gaps in current windows, offering a cost-effective solution for drafts. Replacement involves installing new windows, necessary for severely damaged or inefficient units.
